sloka: मंगलम् कार्य सिद्धि अर्थम् करिष्यन्ति समाहिताः ।ऋषीणाम् च प्रसादेन कपि वृद्ध मतेन च ॥४-६७-३३॥
transliteration: maṁgalam kārya siddhi artham kariṣyanti samāhitāḥ ।ṛṣīṇām ca prasādena kapi vṛddha matena ca ॥4-67-33॥

translations.english: Your well-wishers, the monkey chiefs, have gathered and will with one mind offer auspicious prayers for the success of your mission.
